findings.finding: HTTP call executed while a semaphore was held
findings.evidence: The previous implementation awaited SendAsync before releasing the semaphore; the candidate moves the call outside the critical section while preserving state transition ordering.
findings.recommended_action: Keep only the shared-state transition inside the semaphore and retain the concurrency regression test.

before_evidence: contention test p95=420ms with 32 concurrent workers
after_evidence: contention test p95=145ms with 32 concurrent workers; identical assertion set
open_risks: Production workload distribution may differ from the deterministic test profile.
